Title: Diagnosis of test `testFinish()`

Details:
The test `testFinish()` attempts to verify that calling `finish()` on an `ArchiveOutputStream` after starting an archive entry but before closing that entry results in an `IOException`. This is tested for different archive types: zip, jar, ar, cpio, and tar. The test expects an `IOException` with the message "After putArchive should follow closeArchive" if `finish()` is called with an unclosed entry.

Looking at the `finish()` method implementations for each archive type:

- `ZipArchiveOutputStream.finish()` checks if `entry` (the current archive entry) is not null, and if so, throws an `IOException` with the message "This archives contains unclosed entries.". This matches the test expectations to catch an exception when calling `finish()` on the unclosed entry.
  
- `ArArchiveOutputStream.finish()` similarly throws an `IOException` if `haveUnclosedEntry` is true, with the same message as the zip implementation. This is consistent with the test expectation.

- `CpioArchiveOutputStream.finish()` does a similar null check for an open entry and throws the same IOException message.

- `TarArchiveOutputStream.finish()` writes EOF records but does not check for unclosed entries. This means it will not throw an exception if `finish()` is called with an open archive entry, which fails the test expectation.

- The `JarArchiveOutputStream.finish()` method's code snippet was not retrieved but likely behaves similarly to ZipArchiveOutputStream, since jar is based on zip format.

Therefore, the failure is caused by the `TarArchiveOutputStream.finish()` not throwing the expected `IOException` when an archive entry has been started but not closed. In fact, it unconditionally writes EOF records even if there is an open entry.

This discrepancy in behavior for tar archives causes the test to fail because the exception expected on line 66 when calling `aos1.finish()` is not thrown. The test expects an exception but none is raised, so it calls `fail()`.

Summary:
- The test expects `finish()` to throw IOException on unclosed entries.
- Zip, Ar, Cpio implementations do throw, matching expectations.
- Tar implementation does not throw any exception for unclosed entries.
- Test fails for tar archives due to missing exception in `TarArchiveOutputStream.finish()`.

Suggested fix locations:
- org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveOutputStream.finish()

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
